answer: Make sybils profitable prey, not cheap votes: let anyone post a bounty challenging an identity as a duplicate, priced by an open prediction market. A hollow shell with no real history draws a high sybil probability, so hunters investigate; if proven a duplicate, the challenger takes its rewards and the identity is burned. Each fake account becomes a thread pulling the attacker's whole cluster into view — one confirmed duplicate ripples outward, flagging every identity that attested it, so a sybil farm funds its own exposure.
